"""One-shot audit measurements, no source mutations or remote actions."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = "c683477a5b6f0eb2998a3bac1d547ae92552a77a"
env = dict(os.environ, FORSETI_DIFF_BASE=BASE, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1", PYTHONUTF8="1")
commands = []
for line in (ROOT / ".github/workflows/ci.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
    match = re.match(r"\s*(?:run:\s*)?(python\s+\.agents/hooks/.+)$", line)
    if match:
        command = match.group(1).replace('"$FORSETI_DIFF_BASE"', BASE)
        commands.append((match.group(1), [sys.executable, *shlex.split(command)[1:]]))
results = []
for i, (source_command, argv) in enumerate(commands, 1):
    print(f"[{i}/{len(commands)}] START {source_command}", flush=True)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    record = {"source_command": source_command, "argv": argv, "cwd": str(ROOT), "FORSETI_DIFF_BASE": BASE}
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=30)
        record.update(returncode=proc.returncode, stdout=proc.stdout, stderr=proc.stderr, timeout=False)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        def decode(value):
            return value.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if isinstance(value, bytes) else (value or "")
        record.update(returncode=None, stdout=decode(exc.stdout), stderr=decode(exc.stderr), timeout=True)
    except OSError as exc:
        record.update(returncode=None, stdout="", stderr=str(exc), timeout=False, launch_error=True)
    record["elapsed_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - start
    results.append(record)
    (OUT / "gate_results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[{i}/{len(commands)}] END elapsed={record['elapsed_seconds']:.3f}s rc={record['returncode']} timeout={record['timeout']}", flush=True)
    if record["timeout"]:
        print("Timed-out command stopped; route will not be repeated.", flush=True)
print(json.dumps({"commands": len(results), "seconds": sum(r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in results), "nonzero_or_timeout": sum(r['returncode'] != 0 for r in results)}, indent=2), flush=True)
